12.o: After resting up briefly from the battle with Thenardier's army, Tigre and the others plan to make their way into the Holy Grotto beneath Artesium, to establish Regin's royal identity. However, Thenardier has other plans for them once they arrive.

13.o: Devasted by his surrogate father's loss, Tigre is conforted by Elen. Badouin shows up, and invites Regin back to see the king, who has regained his senses. However, Thenardier stands in their way, and a final showdown between him and Tigre awaits!

1.o: Before we knew how disease spread, medicine was as much superstition as it was science. And in the small New England towns of the 1800s, there is a belief that consumption can only be stopped by making sure the dead are actually dead.

2.o: Dr. Walter Freeman is the father of the icepick lobotomy. He believes the ten-minute procedure will all but end the need for the mental hospital. He has the best of intentions but winds up creating an entirely new kind of horror story.

3.o: In 19th century Ireland, folklore has a strong hold. Michael Cleary is convinced his wife, Bridget, has been replaced by a fairy called a changeling. And his belief drives him to the most extreme act.

4.o: In 19th century America, at the height of the Spiritualist Movement, a haunted house is not just the stuff of ghost stories. Many believe the dead can talk and, sometimes, will come back from the other side to wreak havoc on the living.

5.o: Werewolves are now movie monsters. But they were once thought to be all too real. In 1589, villagers in Bedburg, Germany, are convinced that a werewolf is killing women and children only to discover the killer is really one of their own.

6.o: Robert Gene Otto is a child without friends. That is, until he receives a doll as a gift. He names the doll after himself, Robert. They become fast friends and soon the boy believes the doll is real. But to everyone else...Robert the Doll is a curse.

1.t: Burke and Hare: In the Name of Science
1.o: Two shunned Irish immigrants in Scotland start off as grave robbers to sell the dead to doctors, but decide that creating their own inventory is much easier, and become the most prolific mass-murdering duo in history.

2.o: The aging Countess of Blood, running out of virginal peasants to drain of their youthful essence, brings in a bright-eyed noble to start a new cycle of torture and murder.

3.o: In the German hinterlands, between World Wars, a family goes to bed, not knowing that their killer has been living in the walls and attics of their home like a ghost, watching, waiting for his chance to strike, in one of the most famous unsolved mysteries of all time.

4.t: Prague Clock: The Curse of the Orloj
4.o: As two clockmakers race against the curse of the Orloj, a curse that has already driven the city of Prague to madness and death with the Black Plague, these brothers will discover the price of trying to change history.

5.t: Mary Webster: The Witch of Hadley
5.o: A young woman, raised in a town controlled by a religious zealot, must rectify a fatal mistake before a ravenous mob hangs the Old Witch, Mary Webster, in this story set just 11 years before and 100 miles from Salem, Massachusetts.

6.t: Jack Parsons: The Devil and the Divine
6.o: In 1922, only one person, Jack Parsons, believed that we could send a rocket into space and conjure a demon. By 1952, he had done both. But all he cared about was the Scarlet Woman he had both summoned, and lost, Marjorie Cameron.

1.o: The students face SOE’s demanding selection process. Known as the Student Assessment Board, this intense four-day course puts the students through a series of physical and mental tests, all with the aim of finding out who has the raw talent required to progress to full training. The programme charts the beginning of SOE, which started with a handful of agents, in an organisation determined to find a way back into Nazi-controlled Europe.

2.o: Training begins as the students are schooled in guns, explosives and silent killing techniques. Skills which came together and helped SOE to pull off one of the most audacious assassinations of World War Two. The students need to show a calm head and a killer instinct when handling real weapons, but not everyone makes the grade.

3.o: The students are dropped in the middle of the remote Scottish Highlands, where they learn survival skills required for life in the field. Training in the same mountains as 1940s agents, they are schooled in the same techniques which prepared a group of agents tasked with putting a stop to Hitler's atomic ambitions in Norway. In a freezing Scottish lake and on a sheer rock face, some of the students are forced to find previously-untapped reserves of mental and physical strength.

4.o: The students are transported to a British Stately home - this is SOE Finishing School - a 1940s spy school which prepared agents for a life living undercover in enemy territory. They learn to pick locks, send coded messages and see some real SOE gadgets, before facing an intense mock interrogation designed to prepare agents for the eventuality of capture, torture and possible execution.

5.o: Eight of the original 14 students have fallen by the wayside, leaving just six survivors to undertake SOE’s final scheme – a 24-hour practice mission bringing together all the skills they have learned during training.

8.o: When Grimlock suddenly starts attacking his teammates, Bee must figure out why the stalwart Dinobot has turned from friend to foe.

9.o: While Strongarm's first "solo" mission is marred by an over-protective Bumblebee, Denny's and Fixit's rivalry comes to a head.

10.o: The Bee Team welcomes a visiting Autobot veteran just in time to fend off a Decepticon fugitive bent on monopolizing one of the Bots' most precious commodities.

11.o: While in pursuit of a rebellious Decepticon, Bumblebee is exposed to a toxin that impacts his maturity, leaving the rest of the Bee Team to deal with both an escaped fugitive and a hyperactive leader.

12.o: When two rival Bounty Hunters land on Earth, Bumblebee discovers that there's a price on his head.

13.o: While Bee and his Team try to bring in a gang of Decepticon thieves, Optimus readies himself for a coming evil that will threaten both Earth and Cybertron.

14.o: Bee and his team encounter a new Decepticon who inadvertently leads them to discover Steeljaw's gang.

15.o: A mind-controlling Decepticon captures the Autobots and traps them within nightmares. It's up to Russell to rescue them.

16.o: Sideswipe is captured and has his body stolen by an insane Decepticon.

17.o: Drift returns to Earth in pursuit of a disgruntled, runaway Jetstorm. Meanwhile, Springload and Quillfire make an escape.

18.o: Grimlock tries to hide an injury while the Autobots track down an aquatic Decepticon.

19.o: Grimlock goes up against an unstoppable Decepticon gladiator.

20.o: Fixit needs a repair job from Denny, but it goes wrong and he turns into a sentry bent on wiping out fugitives.

21.o: Steeljaw and his group manage to get into the scrapyard to release cryogenically Decepticon prisoners that the Autobots have captured up to now. Our heroes will have to show cunning to thwart their plan and regain control of the scrapyard.

22.o: Grimlock discovers another Dinobot fugitive with whom he sympathizes. He helps them flee, but it does not take long to destroy everything and terrorize the humans. Our heroes will have to join forces to stop it. Denny redecorates a motor home and Russell is afraid of what his father made.

23.o: Sideswipe meets a female Autobot named Windblade on a mission for Optimus Prime. She agrees to team up with Bumblebee's Team to bring in a Decepticon that has a striking resemblance to a Queen Bee.

24.o: When Bumblebee decides to show his team the beauty of Earth, he takes them to a ghost town in the Far West where a Decepticon able to change form awaits them. As they wonder through the town, the 'Bots get into various hijinks and traps triggered by themselves. Afterwards, Bumblebee finds his team fighting something that isn't really there and stops them. The Decepticon opens various holes in the floor, trapping the 'Bots.

25.o:
In the wake of a coming threat to Earth by Steeljaw's gang, the Primes decide to send Optimus there despite his training not yet complete.

As Optimus prepares to return to Earth to face the mysterious "Evil" he's prophesied, the Bee Team must prevent Steeljaw's Pack from teleporting that same threat onto Earth.

26.o: Reunited with Optimus Prime, Bee and his Team must use everything they’ve learned to stop the annihilation of both Earth and Cybertron.

1.o: The Bee Team must cope with a global Decepticon threat and a weakened Optimus Prime.

2.o: While the away team struggles against the elements to capture Polarclaw, Bumblebee's team tracks Overload.

3.o: While trying to apprehend Saberhorn, Strongarm and Grimlock struggle to recreate the teamwork Strongarm had with Sideswipe.

4.o: After a mistake in the field, Strongarm takes herself out of action just when the team needs her most against fire-starting Decepticons Crazybolt and Slicedice.

5.o: Windblade is concerned about Optimus' well being, but doing so puts the Away Team at risk as they battle Razorpaw.

6.o: Grimlock tries to make himself smarter by absorbing information from a Cybertronian data cylinder into his brain, but something goes wrong and leaves the team at a disadvantage.

7.o: Steeljaw creates a plan to infiltrate the scrapyard by sending Bumblebee, Grimlock, and Strongarm into a trap.

8.o: Bumblebee takes a night off to see his favorite band, but things get dangerous when Bisk attacks the stadium.

9.o: With Bumblebee and Strongarm stuck at an impound lot, Grimlock must find a disguise when Quillfire returns.

10.o: Fixit's repairs to the GroundBridge go wrong, summoning two of the most dangerous Decepticons on the planet and banishing Bumblebee to another dimension.

11.o: Slipstream and Jetstorm expose Drift to danger when attempting to prove that they can work effectively without him.

12.o: After the two teams are reunited, the Autobots get support from an old friend, and begin the raid on Decepticon Island.

13.o: The severely outnumbered Autobots on Decepticon Island desperately search for a way to stop Steeljaw and his army. Tensions between Bumblebee and Optimus could put the mission, and the entire world, at risk.

1.o: In the not-too-distant future of Weird City, Stu and Burt discover that dating is not what it used to be, and love can be found in the most unexpected places.

2.o: Kicked out of his Pomegranate Electrolyte Juice addiction support group and fired from his job, failure Tawny joins ShapeCult gym hoping to find the acceptance he so desperately needs. Unfortunately, his psychotic obsession with approval puts him at odds with his gym trainer.

3.o: School valedictorian Rayna receives a college scholarship and discovers that life is different at her new Above the Line school. Especially when it comes to dating and intimacy, where sexting is the preferred method.

4.o: A couple, Liquia and Jathryn purchase the Smart House of their dreams. However, their dream becomes a nightmare when the house turns on them, threatening their relationship and possibly their lives. Will they be able to outsmart their own smart home?

5.o: When a group of Above-the-Liners decide to sponsor a poor Below the Line kid, they agree to do more than simply donate money. They kidnap him.

6.o: Criminals Charlotta and Glail discover that they actually aren’t who they think they are – they’re really actors on a show that airs in Weird City. Their discovery leads them to question their very existence.

1.o: After discovering an outbreak of a rare and deadly disease, Dr. Lola Spratt and Dr. Owen Maestro team up with a secret unit of the CDC to investigate.

2.o: In Berlin, Owen and Lola meet a subversive ally named the Goldfinch and pursue a suspect who's not what he seems. Or is he?

3.o: Owen and Lola follow a lead to Italy before making a very unclean getaway to Africa, hot on the trail of the mysterious virus's architect.

4.o: After wading into the world of water parks, Owen and Lola head to a swinging Florida retirement community. It's time to save some face -- literally.

5.o: A new threat takes Owen and Lola to Latvia in search of a man named Nikolai. Back in LA, Dr. Cat's talent show demands more skill than she realized.

6.o: A visit to Owen's former mentor in Shanghai leaves him and Lola a bit trigger-happy. The pursuit of a new lead reveals a betrayal by old allies.

7.o: Locked up in a Chinese prison, Lola and Owen run into a friendly face. But they soon find out that being behind bars isn't all fun and games.

8.o: After a daring escape, Owen, Lola and their fellow fugitives hide out in the remote nation of Bhutan, where Lola makes two startling discoveries.

9.o: Lola and Owen return to Childrens Hospital to recover a crucial laptop, but they must contend with attendees of the swanky desk auction to do so.

10.t: Everything Goes Back to Normal … or Do They??
10.o: Childrens Hospital is under attack! Meanwhile, Owen must rely on his surgical prowess to unlock the key secrets of the virus from Lola's mind.

1.o: In this introduction to life on the front lines, doctors in the U.S. and Asia battle the flu, and researchers race to develop a universal vaccine.

2.o: Vaccine debates rage while health-care workers inoculate against the Ebola virus in Congo and influenza in detainee camps at the U.S.-Mexico border.

3.o: Worldwide, scientists test animals and their handlers for emerging viruses. In the U.S. and India, doctors work long hours caring for flu patients.

4.o: Anti-vaccine debate escalates, and medical staff are attacked in Congo. Funding cuts hit hard in the U.S., but researchers in Guatemala make strides.

5.o: Around the world, community, family and faith help physicians and medical advocates stay strong in the face of long hours and a relentless disease.

6.o: Successes for some balance setbacks for others. Meanwhile, viral outbreaks continue to claim lives across the globe — and a larger pandemic looms.

1.o: General Ma of Wei City asks Ning Que to escort Princess Li’s maidservant, of the Tang Empire, back to the capital. Although Ning Que doesn’t want to, he relents because an experienced cultivator, Lu Qing Chen is part of her entourage. He figures out that Princess Li is pretending to be her maidservant, who is fleeing from being murdered by her late husband’s tribe

2.o: To protect Empress Xia Tian, General Xia Hou sets a trap for Princess Li, whose entourage is attacked on their way to the capital. Qing Chen is overpowered by someone in the Demon sect, so Ning Que helps kill the attacker, while Sang Sang protects the princess and her son. Qing Shan, State Preceptor, and General Xia perceive Ning Que as an unknown variable in the struggle for power

3.o: As they head to the capital, Ning Que finds out from Qing Chen that eleven of his seventeen acupuncture points are blocked, rendering him unable to cultivate. Despite, he asks Qing Chen to teach him the cultivation levels for his own knowledge. He keeps getting recurring dreams that haunt him about the sky becoming dark. The official for the department of transport is murdered.

4.o: Ning Que and Sang Sang visit Zeng Manor upon entering the capital. After 15 years, Ning Que reunites with his sworn brother, Zhuo Er. They both have sworn revenge upon General Xia, who killed both of their families when they were young. At the time, they also found Sang Sang as a baby, among the dead. Princess Li meets with her father, Emperor Li

5.o: Ning Que and Sang Sang set up a shop so they can sell Ning Que’s handwriting, but the landlord thinks they won’t be able to stay open for long. After a day of exploring, they see a dead Zhuo Er and look for clues as to the cause of his death. Their sleuthing leads them to Zhang Yi Qi, the transport bureau official, who was previously the Imperial Censor that framed General Lin and causing his death. Prince Long Qing continues his search for the son of Hades.

6.o: As Ning Que seeks out Zhang Yi Qi for revenge, Xiao Shu, leader of the Dragon gang catches him in action. Everyone goes after Xiao Shu who has significant control of revenue in the capital. Xiao Shu invites Ning Que to help him and though Ning Que agrees to help in exchange for some money, that is not the main reason he decides to assist him.

7.o: Reinforcements come to help Ning Que and Xiao Shu at the last minute. Unbeknownst to Grand Prince Li Pei Yan, Xiao Shu has a strong backer in the Imperial Court helping him. Battling together has forged a brotherly bond between Ning Que and Xiao Shu. Prince Long Qing sees the eternal night looming.

8.o: In recognition for helping Xiao Shu, Ning Que is promoted by General Xu as a secret imperial guard, called into action whenever asked of him. Xiao Shu decides to step down as the leader of the Dragon gang, upsetting the Emperor. Prince Long Qing escapes punishment from Luo Kedi, while Prince Chong Ming and He Ming Chi of Xiling Academy collude to take down the Emperor.

9.o: The examination begins for Tang Academy and Ning Que is off to a rolling start. The Emperor doesn’t attend so the target is shifted to another Imperial person. During the assassination attempt, Ning Que springs into action. He encounters Jun Mo and pleads with him to take him as his student disciple. He is then tasked by General Xu to figure out who is behind the assassination attempt.

10.o: Due to the failed assassination attempt, Prince Chong Ming looks for a way out. Prince Long Qing is framed for the murder of Priest Xuan Yi, his teacher. As they attempt to arrest him, Ye Hong Yu from the Monastery of Knowledge and Obeisance, rescues him. Ning Que is miraculously admitted into Tang Academy.

11.o: Ning Que struggles studying on the second floor of the Old Books Building, but perseveres. He learns more about accessing the Two-Story Building and how to become Fu Zi’s personal disciple. Prince Long Qing and Hong Yu try to thwart Luo Kedi’s assassination attempt on Elder Lin Feng. On the way to Princess Li’s birthday banquet, Ning Que confronts Chen Zi Xian, General Lin’s most trusted aide.

12.o: Ning Que does not get a reasonable answer from Chen Zi Xian as to who is behind the killing of Lin Manor, except for a cryptic response “the child of Hades.” His new pen pal, Chen Pi Pi helps him unlock the secret of 2nd floor of Old Books Building. Hong Yu and Long Qing are promoted as the Department Head of Justice and Deputy Head, respectively, making them suspicious of the Justice Department.

13.o: Long Qing requests to be the Grand Priest of Light’s disciple, but he is rejected. His father believes he can be a student of Fu Zi of Tang Academy, so sets him up for the Two Story Building entrance exam. Ning Que checks out Yan Su Qing, the next lead in his investigation. He also learns more about his pen pal, whom he stumps with a mathematical question.

14.o: Su Qing reveals who was behind the plot to frame General Lin and murder his entire manor. He and Ning Que battle to the death. Shortly afterward, the vermillion bird awakens, signaling the Child of Hades is alive. Severely injured, Ning Que’s life hangs by a thread as Chen Pi Pi and Sang Sang scramble to try to save him.

15.o: Ning Que recovers with the help of Chen Pi Pi. General Xia becomes suspicious when three people involved with framing General Lin have all died. Rumors are spreading that Princess Li is the cause of the 6th little prince’s chronic illness, so Prince Hun Yuan decides to do something about it. Xiao Shu is severely injured, while Ning Que tries out some cultivation tricks.

16.o: The Emperor blames Princess Li and Prince Hun Yuan for poisoning the 6th Prince, but Princess Li thinks it’s a ruse concocted by Empress Xia to frame her. Prince Chong Ming is summoned back to the Yan Empire so that Long Qing can replace him and be a disciple of Fu Zi. He and Princess Li commiserate over their misfortunes, then decide to work together to achieve their goals.

17.o: To garner additional support, Princess Li reaches out to Grand Prince Pei Yan. The Emperor, befuddled by Ning Que’s calligraphy, continues his search for the unidentified calligrapher. Ning Que searches for his birth object and is surprised when he discovers what it is.

18.o: Chen Pi Pi tries to convince Ning Que to take the exam to be Fu Zi’s disciple, but Ning Que feels he’s not good enough. So Chen Pi Pi brings him to see Fu Zi’s 2nd disciple, Jun Mo, who inspires him. To make Prince Hun Yuan more disciplined, he enrolled in the military for training. The students of Tang Academy face off with Prince Long Qing.

19.o: Ning Que and Long Qing go after each other’s throats when Ning Que refuses to give Sang Sang to Long Qing. Ning Que embarrasses Long Qing, making him an enemy. Worried about not passing the exam, Ning Que turns to Cheng Pi Pi. Before heading back to Yan Empire, Chong Ming meets with Long Qing to bid farewell.

20.o: For the exam, the candidates are to travel up the mountain, where the first person to reach the mountaintop and retrieve the gourd from the tree will win. Things are not as simple as they seem when the candidates are suddenly beset with challenges throughout their climb. Yan Se’s and Qing Shan’s interest in Qing Nue is renewed when they hear stories of him cultivating when they had previously assessed that his acupoints were blocked, preventing cultivation.

21.o: Yan Se rushes to the two-story building exam, hoping he can get to Ning Que before the winner of the exam is decided. Meanwhile, State Preceptor Qing Shan informs the Emperor that Ning Que is the calligrapher he’s been searching for. Up in the mountain, Ning Que and Long Qing battle internal demons to find their way to the mountaintop.

22.o: Yan Se and Huan He argue over Ning Que’s fate. Though Tang Academy allows Ning Que to be a student of Yan Se after admittance into the Two Story Building, the ultimate decision resides with Ning Que. Having found the mystery calligrapher, the Emperor invites Ning Que to the palace to meet him. Long Qing ponders how he lost to Ning Que, while many begin to target Ning Que.

23.o: General Xia Hou and Wei Guang Ming both target Ning Que, and he suddenly goes missing. Sang Sang and Yan Se search for him while he's held captive. General Xia Hou learns that Ning Que was behind the murders of Su Qin, Chen Zi Xian, and Zhang Yi Qi. Worried Ning Que survived the Lin Manor massacre, he doubles down on ensuring he is killed so the truth can remain hidden.

24.o: Ning Que meets the other disciples of Fu Zi, except for Lee Man Man, who is out with Fu Zi. He receives the amber tablet, symbolizing the embodiment of Fu Zi and solidifying his status as a disciple. He gets his first talisman lesson from Yan Se, and his calligraphy has become a hot commodity in the capital.

25.o: Ning Que has difficulty juggling being a student of both Yan Se and Fu Zi. His brethren Fu Zi disciples are playfully giving him a hard time. Chong Ming returns to the Yan Empire, but his father discovers that his love for Princess Li clouds his judgement, putting their plan at risk. Long Qing becomes the Shrine Leader’s disciple. Princess Li spends more time with Sang Sang, while Ning Que keeps busy with this studies.

26.o: The Grand Priest of Light tells Long Qing he lost to Ning Que because of his fear of the Eternal Night, then he suddenly breaks out of prison to search for the Child of Hades. A tired Ning Que gets inspiration from Chen Pi Pi. The State Preceptor is worried Yan Se is pushing Ning Que too fast and too hard, to the point of breaking him. Ning Que begins learning the Awe-Inspiring Sword technique from Jun Mo.

27.o: While practicing the Awe-Inspiring Sword technique, Ning Que wreaks havoc with his disciple brethren. Given his low cultivation power, they decide to help him out. Due to Ning Que’s innate abilities suitable for talismans, Fu Zi allows him to spend more time with Yan Se to learn. Yan Se reveals to Ning Que that he was chosen to be the protector of the God Startled Formation, just as Yan Se was

28.o: Ning Que begins to look at Yan Se as the father he lost at a young age, and out of the blue while appreciating the rain, he writes his first talisman. As a result, his name appears in the Character Ri Scroll of the Heavenly Scrolls, quickly becoming the target of the Justice Department. As the Eternal Night spreads, barbarians from the wilderness begin moving out of the south and into the north, led by Tang of the Demon Sect.

29.o: Juan Da Jia’s old friend taught Jun Mo the Awe-Inspiring Sword technique and also happens to be Ning Que’s Little Junior Uncle Ke Haoran. Given Xiling is sending the Justice Department and various Southern Jin states to the wilderness to suppress the Demon Sect, the Emperor decides to send Ning Que to lead the Tang Academy students to the wilderness to practice.

30.o: Ning Que tells Sang Sang that she can’t accompany him to the wilderness, then asks Princess Li to take care of her while he’s away. Mo Shan Shan is enthralled with Ning Que’s Chicken Soup post and looks forward to meeting him in the wilderness, but her teacher reminds her she must find the Heavenly Scroll. Yan Se also tells Ning Que to retrieve the Heavenly Scroll and tells him the background story behind it

31.o: Remembering all the adventures they’ve had together, Sang Sang and Ning Que bid a tearful farewell as he goes off to the wilderness. Fu Zi and Lee Man Man continue their search for the Drunkard and the Butcher, who have survived the last Eternal Night a thousand years ago. Wei Guang Ming enters the Tang capital, while Ning Que meets Mo Shan Shan, though hides his identity from her.

32.o: To gain the support of Princess Li, He Ming Chi discloses that the Empress is meeting with the Third Elder of the barbarians. Ning Que, pretending to be Zhong Da Jun, helps Mo Shan Shan and then volunteers to guide her and her students in the deep wilderness to supply the Yan army with rations. Sang Sang meets an old, homeless man who asks her to be his student.

33.o: Wei Guang Ming keeps hounding Sang Sang to be his student and she informs him that she will get Ning Que’s advice before deciding. Mo Shan Shan and her group are attacked by Tang soldiers masquerading as bandits. Though she uses a talisman to ask for help from General Luo, Qu Ni convinces him not to interfere. Ning Que comes face to face with General Xia Hou’s right hand man, who took part in the Lin Manor massacre

34.o: Although Mo Shan Shan has expressed her admiration for Ning Que, he still hides his real identity from her and gives her advice on how to deal with the powerful leaders. Third Elder gives Hun Yuan a lesson after learning he’s been giving the 6th Prince diarrhea medicine. Mo Shan Shan and Chen Jia meet, while the Third Elder and the Empress face off.

35.o: Princess Li rushes to the palace to reveal the Empress is from the Demon Sect, but unbeknownst to her, her father already knows. The Third Elder sacrifices himself for the Empress and for the lives of the barbarians being slaughtered. Mo Shan Shan tries to get justice for the people killed in her group, but General Luo and Qu Ni hinder her efforts, forcing Ning Que to reveal his true identity.

36.o: After learning Ning Que’s true identity, Mo Shan Shan tries to evade him, but relents when he comes to apologize. There is a mutual attraction between them, so when they discover they have the same mission to retrieve the Heavenly Scroll, they decide to go together. Mo Shan Shan’s view of the barbarians is shattered when they befriend a family that is mercilessly killed by deacons from the Justice Department. Meanwhile, Sang Sang becomes Wei Guang Ming’s student of light.

37.o: Shan Shan and Ning Que encounter Long Qing and to stay alive, Ning Que makes a bet with Long Qing on who will reach the next level first. While Long Qing, nears reaching the next level, Ning Que discovers the hidden Main Gate of the Demon Sect. Soon after, his birth element allows him to reach the next level before Long Qing. Angered, Long Qing viciously ambushes Ning Que and Shan Shan.

38.o: Hong Yu seeks to kill Ning Que, but determines they must all work together to navigate the entrance and interior of the Main Gate of the Demon Sect. From a distance, General Xia Hou also hurries to the entrance upon seeing Ning Que break the formation hiding the Main Gate and hearing that Fu Zi may be more powerful than the Master of the Demon Sect, Xiao Tang declares she wants to be Fu Zi’s student

39.o: Although they were able to destroy Lian Sheng, they couldn’t find the Heavenly Scroll. Battered and injured, Ning Que, Shan Shan, and Hong Yu look for a way out of the gate. Yan Se is concerned that Guang Ming’s target is Ning Que after seeing him stay with Sang Sang. A fight between them is inevitable, pitting the master of Ning Que against the master of Sang Sang

40.o: Yan Se finally realizes that Sang Sang is a student of Guang Ming. He spends the day with Guang Ming for old times' sake, but they are unable to sway the beliefs each other possesses. They prepare for battle the next day, and Sang Sang is saddened that two good people are determined to fight each other. Pi Pi and Jun Mo attend the battle to help protect Sang Sang.

41.o: While battling, Yan Se and Guang Ming attain Dao by breaking through all five of the levels. To exit the Main Gate of the Demon Sect, Ning Que, Shan Shan, and Hong Yu rely on Tang Xiao Tang, who agrees to lead them out if Ning Que promises to help her become a student of the Tang Academy. With the help of Lee Man Man, Ning Que convinces Shan Shan to go to Tang Academy with them.

42.o: Fu Zi tracks down the Drunkard and the Butcher to ask them questions about the previous Eternal Night. Long Qing can’t reconcile that he is no longer the Child of Light and that his life now has no meaning without the ability to cultivate. Lee Man Man takes Ning Que and Shan Shan to meet with General Xia Hou, where he makes it clear that he should stop targeting his junior brother.

43.o: Long Qing wanders the world in his decrepit state, while Chen Jia continues to follow him in hopes that he will change his mind to be with her regardless of his new state. Ning Que’s demonic cultivation reaches a new high when he’s confronted by Lin Ling, but he struggles to accept his newfound power. Sang Sang is taken in for questioning by the Amy Ministry.

44.o: Princess Li asks the Emperor to Sang Sang but learns that Xiling will be coming to take Sang Sang to the Peach Mountains to inherit the Holy Seat of the Light as successor to Guang Ming. Despite Fu Zi’s rule that Tang Academy doesn’t get involved in court affairs, Chen Pi Pi comes to rescue Sang Sang. Princess Li invites Sang Sang to the banquet the Empress is hosting, where one of the official’s wives takes a keen interest in Sang Sang

45.o: Sang Sang’s mother and father urged her to go back with them instead of staying as a servant maid for Ning Que. Given she’s spent all of her years growing up with Ning Que, she doesn’t want to go with them. When Ning Que returns, Sang Sang sees Shan Shan and tries to avoid Ning Que. She brings him the pots of Yan Se and Guang Ming, but he is upset that the teacher she admires took part in the massacre of the Lin Manor.

46.o: At the Justice Department, the handkerchief from Mu You reminds Hong Yu of Ning Que. Ning Que spends his days giving Shan Shan tours of the capital, while Sang Sang wonders if it will be the three of them eating dinner henceforth. Guan Hai from the Heavenly Pillar Sect challenges Ning Que, who is anxious about not revealing his demonic cultivation. Sang Sang sees the affection between Ning Que and Shan Shan growing

47.o: Sang Sang believes Shan Shan is better than her in many ways, so she decides to live with her parents in Zeng Manor without telling Ning Que. Ning Que knows something is wrong when Sang Sang goes missing, so he desperately searches for her. They argue about Sang Sang coming back with him or staying at Zeng Manor. Fu Zi’s disciples are also split on who Ning Que should marry.

48.o: The disciples pick sides on who Ning Que should marry, but in the end, they agree it is his decision. Ning Que is again challenged to a duel, but this time, it is against Qu Ni’s son. The demon in Ning Que comes out, and the battle doesn’t end well, though it suddenly dawns on him that Sang Sang has been in his heart all along. He makes things clear with Shan Shan, then unexpectedly meets Fu Zi while drinking away his sorrows.

49.o: Sang Sang hears Ning Que is severely injured, so hurries home to care for him. Things seem to have gone back to normal between them as Shan Shan heads back to Grand River State. Xiling uses the death of Dao Shi to send Liu Yi Qing to challenge Ning Que. Fu Zi punishes Ning Que by locking him up at the Repenting Cliff to reflect on himself and not allowing him to leave until he has thought everything through

50.o: Unbeknownst to Ning Que, Fu Zi has locked him in the Repenting Cliff for his protection and safety. He learns that his junior Uncle was able to break through in 3 years, so Ning Que doubles down to make sure he also breaks through…at some point. Long Qing is once again inspired by his teacher, Chen Mou and learns from the beginning. The Grand Priest of Revelation and Li Xue head to Tang empire to bring Sang Sang back to Xiling.

51.o: Tang Xiao Tang not only makes a good impression on Chen Pi Pi, but she also becomes a student of Yu Lian. All of Ning Que’s brothers and sisters help him control the Awe-Inspiring Energy and pass the time in the Repenting Cliff. After 3 months, the Xiling envoy arrives to take Sang Sang. Ning Que springs into action and not only stops them but also conquers Liu Yi Qing

52.o: Chen Mou helps Long Qing recover his hope and faith in the light, allowing him to go to the Monastery of Knowledge and Obeisance. After leaving the Repenting Cliffs, Ning Que is officially acknowledged by Fu Zi as his student, then sends him back to the Repenting Cliffs. Ning Que and Sang Sang meet with the Grand Priest of Revelation to discuss when Sang Sang goes to Xiling. Chao Xiao awakens in a remote village, while Liu Bao forsakes the Justice Department

53.o: Li Xue convinces Xia Hou to ascend to the next level by dying via a magical weapon and then taking the Heaven Channeling Ping. Long Qing enters the Monastery of Knowledge and Obeisance, vowing to the climb to the top of cultivation. Hong Yu receives the Grand River Sword from Liu Bai, while Ning Que receives the formation eye pestle that Yan Se left him, which controls the God Startled Formation that protects the Tang Empire

54.o: The Empress tries to find out what is causing the feud between Ning Que and her brother, Xia Hou. Ning Que and Sang Sang go to great lengths to purchase Yanming Lake for their future planning. Long Qing is getting impatient with his weak cultivation and chances upon the Heavenly Channeling Pills. Hong Yu has regained her cultivation strength thanks to Liu Bai and teaches General Luo a lesson

55.o: Ning Que’s brothers and sisters help him prepare Yanming Lake for his showdown with General Xia. The sage that Long Qing encounters in a cave gives him ideas about making his own Heavenly Channeling Pill. General Xia meets with the Shrine Leader before heading back to the capital and is surprised by what is told to him. Ning Que meets General Xu Shi who warns him not to fight against General Xia

56.o: Chen Pi Pi likes Xiao Tang, but because she is a saintess of the Demon Sect, he knows it could never be possible between them. The Shrine leader implies that Hong Yu has been corrupted by Ning Que, prompting her older brother, Ye Qing, to go after him. Hong Yu arrives at Ning Que’s doorstep, asking him for accommodations. Xia Hou has arrived at the capital and is eagerly awaiting his battle with Ning Que.

57.o: Xia Hou invites Ning Que to a meal to try and provoke him, but Hong Yu tags along to keep him from making rash decisions. Hong Yu knows Ning Que is at a disadvantage so she lets him borrow Liu Bai’s sword to learn the Grand River Sword Force technique. Ye Qing enters the capital looking for Ning Que and Xia Hou. Chen Pi Pi meets with Ye Qing to explain why he left the Monastery of Knowledge and Obeisance

58.o: Ning Que asks Hong Yu to teach Sang Sang, given she is the successor of the Grand Priest of Light. The sage in the cave decides to give Long Qing half of his cultivation, but Long Qing becomes greedy for power and takes it all. He also steals the Heavenly Channeling pill plus other items from the Monastery of Knowledge and Obeisance. The Grand Prince and the Emperor battle it out as the massacre 16 years ago comes to light

59.o: Grand Prince Li admits his crimes to the Emperor and asks to lose his royal status as punishment. General Xia Hou admits he killed the people of Lin Manor but righteously proclaims that his misdeeds in the past should not overshadow all of his achievements as a General over the years. 1.o: بتهور ودون أن يخبر والدته، يتبع المراهق الجاد "كاميرون" صديقه المقرّب "راي" إلى معسكر تدريب مشاة البحرية ويواجه تحدياته القاسية.

2.o: يوضع الترابط بين "كاميرون" و"راي" في أزمة خلال تمرين تدريبي يجبر الشقيقين "جون" و"كودي" على تفريغ الكبت في علاقتهما الأسرية الذي يحملانه معهما إلى "باريس أيلند".

3.o: يبذل "كاميرون" قصارى جهده لإثبات ذاته في واحدة من دورات بناء الثقة، وينضم مجنّد جديد إلى الفصيلة، وتكتشف "باربرا" أنّ للتعاطف منافع كثيرة.

4.o: وسط أسبوع مخصص للتدريب على السباحة حافل بالضغوط الهائلة، يعاني "راي" ليبقى متماسكًا... إلى أن يغامر "كاميرون" بخطة محفوفة بالمخاطر لإنقاذه من الغرق.

5.o: تشتعل العواطف مع سعي "كاميرون" والمجندين إلى إصابة أهدافهم في تدريب الرماية، في حين يسقط الرقيب "سوليفان" وسط مرمى نيران من نوع آخر.

6.o: يعاني جنود الفصيلة من تبعات الالتحاق بمشاة البحرية، وتنقل النقيب "فاهاردو" آخر المستجدّات إلى رقيب تدريب المجندين "ماكينون"، وتنتشر الفوضى في صالة الطعام.

7.o: مع بدء التدريب على مهارات القتال، تدفع لعبة ذهنية وحشية أحد المجنّدين إلى حافة الانهيار، في حين يُحدث انتهاك للبروتوكول بلبلة في صفوف الفصيلة.

8.o: يواجه المجنّدون الاختبار النهائي، إذ تدفعهم "البوتقة" إلى أقصى حدود التحمّل... ولا سبيل للنجاح في تخطّيه إلا بروح التعاون والأخوّة.

1.o: يتقاطع دربا "موهي تشا" و"هوجين جو"، اللذان يأملان في طيّ صفحة الماضي، في طوكيو، حيث يلتقيان صدفة في مطعم "رامن". وهناك، تتوسّل "موهي" إلى "هوجين" لترجمة مشاعرها.

2.o: تتحول "موهي" فجأة إلى نجمة عالمية، لكنها تجد صعوبة في مغادرة الشخصية التي تجسدها أثناء التصوير. أمّا "هوجين" المنزعج، فيصبح حديث الجميع على منصة "إنستغرام".

3.o: تلتقي "موهي" و"هيرو" صدفة في حفل رسمي راقٍ، وحين يثيران جلبة أمام الكاميرا دون قصد، تلهم الشعلة التي تتقد بينهما عملية اختيار طاقم برنامج "رحلة رومانسية".

4.o: بسبب استيائه من زميلته الجديدة في التمثيل، يقرر "هيرو" أن يُصعّب عليها الأمر أثناء التصوير في "كندا"، في حين يصبح "هوجين" أكثر دعمًا لـ"موهي" كلما تعمّق في التعرّف إليها.

5.o: يستمتع "هيرو" بوقته مع "موهي"، على الرغم من إصراره على كرهها. وفي الأثناء، يصادف "هوجين" منتجة جديدة، الأمر الذي يفاجئه تمامًا.

6.o: ثمة سرّ يوطد العلاقة بين "يونغ يو كيم" و"جي سون"، فيما تلقي "موهي" اللوم على "دو را مي" لتصرّف جريء قُبيل سهرة مع الفريق تجعل "هوجين" يتخبط في مشاعره.

7.o: يغادر "هيرو" إلى "سول" في رحلة لاكتشاف الذات وفهم مشاعره بشكل أكبر، فيما يحضر "يونغ هوان كيم" حفلة موسيقية، ويرتب إثرها لقاء يجمع بين "موهي" و"هوجين"، الذي يأتي على مضض.

8.o: تتغيّر علاقة "موهي" و"دو را مي" مع تراكم اللحظات المحرجة مع العائلة والأصدقاء والزملاء من النجوم... الأمر الذي يدفع بأحدهم إلى اتخاذ إجراء صارم.

9.o: يبوح كل من "موهي" و"هيرو" بمشاعرهما أثناء التصوير في إيطاليا، وبينما تسري الشائعات بين الطاقم حول حبيبته المزعومة، يدرك "هوجين" حقيقة صادمة عن "دو را مي".

10.o: بينما يتأقلم مع علاقته الجديدة، يلتئم شمل "هوجين" مع فرد مهم من أسرته في مصنع نبيذ فاخر. أمّا "موهي"، فتفهم السبب الرئيسي لكل مشاكلها.

11.o: تجد "موهي" و"هوجين" نفسيهما في مواجهة الماضي بعد أن تتناقل وسائل الإعلام خبرًا فاضحًا. وعلى صعيد آخر، يثير منشور على منصة "إنستغرام" أسئلة مهمة بعد أن يُسلط الضوء عليه مجددًا.

12.o: بينما تنكشف بعض الأسرار وتتوطّد بعض العلاقات الرومانسية، هل ستتمكن "موهي" و"هوجين" من بلوغ نهاية قصتهما السعيدة... أم أن بعض المشاعر قُدّر لها أن تبقى صعبة الفهم إلى الأبد؟
